# nish\:compact

The marker interfaces that pick a class's layout (WP48). `class R implements Compact` stores every field typed exactly `R` or `R | null`, in any class, as a 32-bit offset into one reserved address range, so a tree or list node of an `i32` and two links is 12 bytes, not 24. Locals, parameters, returns, arrays, maps and other unions stay full pointers.

```ts
import {
  Compact,
  Wide,
} from "nish:compact";
```

<scalar-grid cols="2">

<scalar-card title="Compact" icon="phosphor/regular/cube" href="#compact">

The marker a class implements to store its links as 32-bit offsets.

</scalar-card>

<scalar-card title="Wide" icon="phosphor/regular/cube" href="#wide">

Reserved for WP48 stage 3, which lets a class refuse a layout the compiler picks.

</scalar-card>

</scalar-grid>

<scalar-callout type="info">

A `--emit-header` build keeps a compact class, and every class holding one
of its links, opaque: C holds it as a full `struct X *` handle and links the
range runtime (`scripts/build.sh --arena-range`). The compiler refuses a
compact class where Node or the runtime would read its layout: a build with
`--emit-napi` or `--emit-napi-async` (also beside `--emit-header`), an
N-API export whose signature holds one, a `declare class`, and a class
holding a `Secret`. wasm32, a host `--emit-dts` page module and an ASAN build compile
it uncompressed: a pointer there is already 4 bytes, the page runs on the
wasm runtime, or the range cannot hold the sanitizer's blocks.

</scalar-callout>

<scalar-detail title="Under Node">

`runtime/nish.mjs` answers the import with
`runtime/core.mjs`, where both names are empty values: a reference is the
engine's own and the marker changes nothing a program prints.

</scalar-detail>

Rules: https://github.com/amritk/nish/blob/main/docs/LANGUAGE.md#compact-classes

## Interfaces

### Compact

The marker a class implements to store its links as 32-bit offsets. It
has no members, so `implements Compact` adds no field.

```ts
interface Compact
```

### Wide

Reserved for WP48 stage 3, which lets a class refuse a layout the
compiler picks. Accepted today and changes nothing.

```ts
interface Wide
```
